attackers_goals: An attacker is attempting to exploit AD CS misconfigurations to obtain certificates that can be used for credential theft and privilege escalation.
description: A certificate template was updated with a possible misconfiguration. This may indicate the exploitation of misconfigured certificate template access control (ESC4).
investigative_actions: Review the AD CS configuration for vulnerable templates and EKU settings.* Review AD CS logs to identify any unauthorized certificate issuances, modifications, or template changes.
name: Suspicious certificate template modification
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)

variations.name: Certificate template was updated to be vulnerable to AD CS ESC attack
variations.description: A certificate template was updated, making it vulnerable to an AD CS ESC attack. This may indicate the potential abuse of AD CS ESC4.
